name: Brick-local Gradient Estimation
definition: Computes the ISO gradient using central differences within a single brick's atlas slot to avoid indirection lookups in the hot loop. Offsets are clamped to the sampleable range to handle brick boundaries.
summary: Brick-local Gradient Estimation computes per-brick gradients using clamped central differences to avoid global pre-computation and indirection lookups, optimizing brick-based out-of-core rendering.
